The bull case assumes genuine stock momentum, but the cross-sectional momentum rank is dead neutral (50.1) — there is no momentum edge to ride, only high realized vol (0.62) and a 3.2 beta, so any upside is really a leveraged market bet in a regime that breaks trend models. With beta 3.16, no fresh information, and downside 3-6% against 3% of headroom, the trade is a coin flip priced as a setup.
